scope: PROP-FLOOD-06.v2 (registry/proposals/flood_outlet_coping.json): one method-domain (M) proposal for a community flood-readout application (FloodConnect), via the governed proposals-lane intake process -- NOT promoted into registry/CANONICAL.json. This branch (proposals/flood-outlet-coping) was rebased onto origin/main (bringing in PR #59, PROP-FLOOD-01/02, registry/proposals/flood_readout_trend.json) and additionally merges the still-open PR #60 (proposals/flood-water-balance, PROP-FLOOD-03, registry/proposals/flood_water_balance.json) and PR #62 (proposals/flood-burden-ledger, PROP-FLOOD-05a/b, registry/proposals/flood_burden_ledger.json) so that every parent PROP-FLOOD-06 cites is physically present and independently readable in this branch, per independent-review MUST-FIX #1 (REVIEW_PROP_FLOOD_06.md). Those two merged branches' own content/ACK coverage is unchanged by this merge (no hand-edit); this ACK covers only the v2 statement-change to PROP-FLOOD-06 itself, described below. PROP-FLOOD-06 is an area-generic outlet-headroom/drainage-coping indicator for a declared drainage unit U (village/district/province/sub-basin, tuple <A_U,O_U,P_U,c_U>): outlet headroom R_H(U), drainage-clearable volume D_H(U), forecast inflow F_H(U), severity ratio S_H(U)=F_H/min(D_H,R_H), and urgency readout T_act(U) (a direct PROP-FLOOD-02 time-to-threshold instantiation), combined into a declared >=5-level tier ladder. v2 AMENDMENTS (per independent review, all three MUST-FIX items plus one cheap SHOULD-FIX): (1) parent chain made verifiable in-branch as described above; (2) coq/canonical/PROP_FLOOD_06_outlet_coping_tier.v's s_band boundary values corrected -- 0.3/0.6/0.9/1.2 now close the UPPER band (L1/L2/L3/L4), matching the JSON/MD exactly (v1's Coq had them inverted, closing the LOWER band); boundary lemmas added at every edge; (3) the L5-pre-check-vs-'S_H:=0,OK' ambiguity is resolved: L5's zero-capacity disjunct is now gated on F_H(U)>0, the former ZERO_CAPACITY_NONZERO_INFLOW refusal code is REMOVED (that case is now the L5 tier, not a refusal -- 'the system is already exceeded' is a valid resident-facing readout), and a new single total function full_tier over (refused, D_H, R_H, F_H, S_H, T_act) is added to the same Coq file with its own totality/decidability theorems; (4) g_U(t) no longer silently defaults to 1 -- undeclared is REFUSED (new code DERATING_UNDECLARED), a unit wanting g_U(t)=1 (Bangkok) declares it explicitly tagged OPEN; (5) unit-resolution declared defaults added: CRS EPSG:4326, nearest-k=3 gauges within 10 km else NO_GAUGE_IN_UNIT, staleness windows 3h (live)/24h (forecast), ensemble = models actually present at evaluation time (logged per-run), tie-break = smallest asset_id. Proposal bumped to version v2 with a version_history/LINEAGE.jsonl entry (code weld/M.??.v1, event revised) per this repo's revision convention. No claim about the Clay Millennium Navier-Stokes problem, or about any object's Clay/NS status, is made or implied anywhere in this change; the status of every existing Clay-related registry object (CANONICAL.json, coq/canonical/ pre-existing files, docs/CLAY_*) is unchanged.
